name: 25347-imagetag-qwen3vl-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. Public, ungated, image-text-to-text, 8.9 GB of bf16 safetensors.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 10000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn image tagging: one 256x256 JPEG plus a ~32-token instruction per request, 32 output tokens, image and prompt distinct on every request. Two guidellm synthetic datasets zipped row-wise -- synthetic_text supplies the prompt and the output length, synthetic_image the picture (jpeg, seed 42, one per request).
purpose: A photo tagging service labeling one small thumbnail per request with brief keywords, 64 concurrent streams, single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 1c3ffdbeccaf75f7b885b1700a4011fb4f63a7ab (git describe
# v0.10.2rc2-325-g1c3ffdbeccaf); the interpreter is named by configs/env.yaml `venv:`.
# Engine defaults are written out rather than left implicit so they cannot drift.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-model-len: 4096
